title: polanisia dodecandra subsp. trachysperma
intro: Polanisia dodecandra subsp. trachysperma, commonly known as African Black Soap Plant, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Polanisia dodecandra subsp. trachysperma include its ability to soothe skin irritations, treat acne, and alleviate symptoms of eczema and other skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
